verdict.rationale: Datalab supports webhooks that fire automatically when processing jobs complete, and pipelines let you chain processors into reusable workflows, giving some event-driven automation. However, there's no evidence of a genuine rules engine where users define arbitrary conditions/triggers (e.g., 'if field X extracted equals Y, then run Z') beyond job-completion notifications and static pipeline chains. Missing for 10: conditional rule definition (if/then logic), custom event types beyond job completion, and any UI/API for user-defined trigger conditions.
